text.content:
The detective who taught Minako to tail, lie, wait and shoot.

Role: Detective
Affiliation: Danger Gal
Status: Whereabouts not disclosed

A hardboiled detective who ran all of Danger Gal's detective groups, said to have been a very experienced mercenary before that. After Minako's kidnapping in 2045, Michiko made him her daughter's mentor. Danger Gal won't say where he is now. His file is four pages long, and three of them are black bars under federal redactions.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.05; Danger Gal Dossier
